description.en: The preview of a file whose same-site preview url is a property of a data source row (permission-checked). PDF, images and text show inline.
description.fa: پیش‌نمایش فایلی که نشانی آن ویژگی یک ردیف است.

srcField.description: The row property that holds the preview url (/Files/Preview/12)

titleField.description: The row property that holds the file name

annotationsUrl.description: SCRUM-775: the data source of the pins of the file, a /d/{key} url filtered to the file; with it (or saveUrl) the preview gets a page bar and pins

saveUrl.description: SCRUM-775: the stored action that saves a pin { id, fileId, page, x, y, note } (/a/{action}); it applies the record permission. Without it the pins are read only

deleteUrl.description: SCRUM-775: the stored action that deletes a pin { id }
